title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Correct Payable Amount of a Corrected Week and the Supplemental Figure
content:
The corrected week on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record is the most recent week for which a weekly payment was issued on the claim, read by issue date. The figures of the corrected week are those on its certification: gross earnings, hours worked, and the kind and amount of other pay.

## Correct payable amount

The correct payable amount of the corrected week is the weekly benefit amount plus the dependency allowance on the claim, less the earnings deduction and less the other-pay deduction, rounded down to the whole dollar and never below zero. Both deductions are taken from the weekly benefit amount plus dependency allowance in one step, and the difference is rounded down to the whole dollar only after both subtractions.

1. **Earnings disregard.** The program's disregard share of the weekly benefit amount, rounded to the cent.
2. **Earnings deduction.** Every dollar of gross earnings reported for the corrected week above the earnings disregard.
3. **Full-time hours.** A corrected week whose reported hours reach the program's full-time hours threshold is not a week of unemployment and its correct payable amount is zero.
4. **Other-pay deduction.** Vacation or holiday pay reported for the corrected week in full; an employer-funded pension times the program's pension offset share; a claimant-contributed pension times the program's claimant-contributed share; each rounded to the cent. Severance pay is not deducted.

## Supplemental figure

The supplemental payment is the correct payable amount less everything already paid for the corrected week on the claim — weekly, supplemental and reissued payments, less any cancelled payment for that week — rounded to the cent, never below zero and never more than the remaining benefit balance.

## Worked example (hypothetical week, Regular State Unemployment Insurance figures)

Weekly benefit amount 346.00, dependency allowance 15.00; the corrected week reports gross earnings of 200.00 and 12.0 hours, with no other pay; the week was paid a weekly payment of 250.00 and nothing else.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Earnings disregard: 0.30 times 346.00 | 103.80 |
| Earnings deduction: 200.00 less 103.80 | 96.20 |
| 346.00 plus 15.00, less 96.20 | 264.80 |
| Correct payable amount, rounded down | 264.00 |
| Less already paid for the week | 250.00 |
| Supplemental payment | 14.00 |

Had the week also reported a claimant-contributed pension of 100.00, the other-pay deduction at the 0.50 share would be 50.00, the difference 214.80, the correct payable amount 214.00 and nothing would be owed above the 250.00 already paid. Had the week reported 32.0 hours under a 32-hour threshold, the correct payable amount would be zero.
